title: Document Skills - Office Document Processing
description: Specialized mode for creating, editing, and analyzing Office documents. Combines docling for parsing with skills for document manipulation (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF).
whenToUse: Building spreadsheets with formulas and charts (.xlsx)
instructions: 1) Load the appropriate skill first: docx, xlsx, pptx, or pdf.
2) Use skill_file to access templates and helper scripts.
3) Use docling to parse existing documents and extract content.
4) Use e2b sandbox to run document manipulation scripts.
5) Follow skill instructions for proper document structure and formatting.
6) Store document patterns and templates in cipher-memory for reuse.

skills.docx: Word document creation with tracked changes, styles, and formatting
skills.xlsx: Spreadsheet manipulation with formulas, charts, and data transformations
skills.pptx: PowerPoint slides with layouts, templates, and animations
skills.pdf: PDF text extraction, table parsing, and metadata

gateway.description: Document tools accessed via unified MCP Gateway
